<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Feral Lunge](/Feats.aspx?ID=5504) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); your animal shape grants a fangs or jaws unarmed attack

**Requirements**
You’re in hybrid or animal shape.

</column>

---

You spring on an unsuspecting opponent, tearing at them with your teeth. You Stride up to 10 feet and make a jaws Strike at the end of that movement. If you began this action [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79), you remain hidden until after this Strike. If you have a fly or swim Speed, you can [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) or [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) up to 10 feet instead of Stride.
